description: Ministry of Water Supply & Estate Infrastructure Development - Correction Notice, Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2197/23, dated 15.10.2020, Kandy District
reasoning: This gazette content is primarily concerned with land and property matters. It contains a detailed correction to land boundaries, measurements (perches, roods), lot numbers, and specific descriptions of adjacent properties and their claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land registration details and boundary amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While a government minister is named, this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers related to land matters, not for personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
